definitions.explanation: The complete amount or every part of something.

examples.japanese: {全部|ぜんぶ}⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全部|ぜんぶ}⟦{終|お}わりました→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I finished all of my homework.

examples.japanese: {全部|ぜんぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いくら→いくら：00943_ikura⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much is it in total?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{全部|ぜんぶ}⟦{読|よ}みました→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全部|ぜんぶ}⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to answer all the questions on the test.

notes:
{全部|ぜんぶ} means 'all,' 'everything,' or 'the whole thing.' It functions as both a noun and an adverb.

USAGE AS NOUN:
- {全部|ぜんぶ}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: I'll take all of it
- {全部|ぜんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧: all the books

USAGE AS ADVERB:
- {全部|ぜんぶ}⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: I ate all of it
- {全部|ぜんぶ}⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧: It's all finished

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {全部|ぜんぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧〜: ~ in total, altogether
- {全部|ぜんぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: 1000 yen in total

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧: all, everything (slightly more formal)
- ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧: everyone, all (for people/casual)
- ⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all members, everyone (for groups)
- ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧: the whole, entirety
- ⟦{合計|ごうけい}→合計：02817_goukei⟧: total (numerical sum)

USAGE:
{全部|ぜんぶ} is used for things, while ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧ is often used for people.
